answer: An operator leases one numbered fire lookout on a coastal summit. Only that holder may train a uniquely tagged bean on the lookout's windward trellis and, at an unannounced dawn, wring a sealed dew cup from those leaves into the official cistern while the ocean lightship flashes the day's code. Graders match plant tag, cistern chemistry, lookout log, and the lightship plate. A shared lookout, a transplanted vine, or a missed flash is forfeited as one farm. N aliases cost N exclusive summit cabins, N living trellises, and N live code-matched dawns no single runner can cover.
